format: Makefile (shell scripting and GNU Make syntax)
description: This file is a kernel build makefile for the OpenWrt project, defining build rules, dependencies, and download procedures for kernel compilation, configuration, and debugging.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage
methods.description: Default kernel image compilation including initramfs.

methods.name: Kernel/Clean
methods.description: Default cleaning step for kernel build artifacts.

methods.name: Download/kernel
methods.description: Defines kernel source URL, file, and hash for download.

methods.name: Download/git-kernel
methods.description: Defines git repository URL, version, and options for kernel source.

methods.name: Kernel/CollectDebug
methods.description: Collects kernel debug symbols and creates a debug tarball.
